headline: Former American businessman detained in Myanmar after alleged financial misconduct
context: Adam Castillo, founder of AGS Myanmar, was detained Thursday at Yangon International Airport. The U.S. State Department is aware of a reported detention but hasn't commented further.

sources.name: NPR
